subject: thm-a-bounded-partition-into-weakly-restricted-sets
subclass_note: The old dense-branch absorption argument asserted that the enlarged part stayed above self-density 1-epsilon without choosing a bound that controlled the 1/|X_i| term or handling small orders. The accepted repair replaced that branchwise heuristic with a full repeated-extraction proof and an explicit remainder-absorption estimate.

subject: fs-a-sparse-set-contains-a-stable-set-of-half-its-size
subclass_note: The old refutation chose a graph described as a disjoint union of 1/c cliques of order cn without making 1/c an integer, so the witness was not well-defined. The repaired witness fixes n>8 divisible by 4 and takes four cliques of order n/4.

subject: thm-every-maximal-eventown-family-is-maximum
subclass_note: The old step 4.1 asserted the codimension-one drop from U^perp to U^perp∩H with no licensed fact that H cuts U^perp by exactly one dimension in the odd case or equals it in the even case. The repair splits parity, using rank-nullity for a nonzero linear functional in the odd case and maximality plus the all-ones vector in the even case.

subject: cor-rodl-every-h-free-graph-has-a-linear-restricted-set
subclass_note: The source theorem and the proof both require G to be nonempty, and restricted sets are defined only for nonempty vertex sets. The old title and Statement quantified over all H-free finite simple graphs, including the null graph, and were narrowed to the nonempty case.

subject: cor-rodl-in-the-edge-density-form
subclass_note: The old title and Statement quantified over all H-free graphs although the density d_G(X,X) is only defined for nonempty X and the proof inherits the nonempty hypothesis from the preceding corollary. The claim was narrowed to nonempty H-free finite simple graphs.

subject: cor-nikiforov-applies-to-every-linearly-large-induced-subgraph
subclass_note: The old proof set delta = delta_0/lambda and then used the inequality in the wrong direction at step 3.1, claiming delta_0|W| >= delta|W|. The repair sets delta = min{delta_0, lambda delta_0} and carries the inherited threshold through the proof in the correct direction.

subject: cor-boundedly-many-restricted-sets-cover-all-but-a-small-fraction
subclass_note: The old Statement claimed the existence of exactly t nonempty restricted sets, while the proof only showed that the extraction process stops after some number of steps bounded by t. The claim was narrowed to X_1,...,X_s for some s <= t, and step 3.1 was aligned to that bound.
